 De Zerbi on when Tosin, Bergvall, Mudryk and Savio could return
 31 10월 2026 
 -->
 Roberto De Zerbi has provided an update on the potential return dates for injured quartet Tosin Adarabioyo, Lucas Bergvall, Mykhailo Mudryk and Savio.
 The foursome have missed at least a game each while Mykhailo has been out of action since September, but Roberto has offered a positive update on the group.
 While loanee from Chelsea Mudryk and fellow summer arrival Savio are expected to be sidelined until after the international break, there is a chance both Tosin and Bergvall could be back when we take on Leeds United at Elland Road next Saturday.
 Team news | Roberto’s positive update on ‘special’ Maddison
 30 10월 2026 
 -->
 "Before the international break, for Tosin and Bergvall. Maybe," Roberto said as he spoke to SPURSPLAY on Friday afternoon. "Maybe not from the beginning against Leeds but available yes, I hope so. Mudryk and Savio after the international break."
 Meanwhile, our Head Coach provided an update on Wilson Odobert.
 The forward has been out of action since February with an anterior cruciate ligament injury (ACL) but could be back in training at the turn of the year.
 Team news | Udogie back, Bergvall, Savio, Tosin out for Palace clash
 30 10월 2026 
 -->
 "(He should be back in training) After December. After Christmas. In January, I think. It is a great thing for us."
